hypothesis: The old semantic corrector extrapolated on missing-primary rows, breaking 30 previously correct all-missing user5 rows. Restrict training and inference to rows with both decodable primary modalities.
inputs: Existing deployment-aligned unscaled40-class Visual logits, Temporal logits, baseline; no new upstream tuning. Availability mask from raw training input validity audit.

training.loss: CE plus KL weight1 for correct baseline confidence>=.8
training.precision: FP32 head training and stored state

stopping_rule: No recipe tuning on held outcomes. No test inference/full-fit/submission unless gates pass.
